# Independent receiving review: product-Choi PBT bridge
2026-10-29. ACCEPTED at the finite product-resource channel scope, with the frozen Choi-register convention correction.

## Load-bearing mathematics
The PGM effects are positive and sum to the identity after the uniform kernel completion. A known finite Naimark implementation exists; its large memory/gate costs are not erased by specifying it.

Bell contraction gives the stated entanglement-fidelity expression. On each P_i support, rank-r Cauchy–Schwarz and scalar spectral Jensen yield1/Tr(P_i rho). The singular rho causes no missing zero-eigenvalue contribution because ker(rho) is orthogonal to every im(P_i). The exact Bell overlap r/d^2 then gives F_e>=N/(N+d^2-1), with the same normalized-resource convention as the executable.

Global unitary covariance includes the kernel completion and output-port routing. Thus the unconditional channel is depolarizing. Its Weyl mixture has identity coefficient F_e; convexity bounds half diamond by1-F_e, and the maximally entangled input attains that value. This is not an inference from generic Choi fidelity without covariance.

For product identical CPTP Choi resources, each port's channel can be commuted through the Alice-only measurement. Trace preservation removes every unselected port map, giving EXACT E composed with T_N. Nonidentical independent ports give sum_i E_i composed with T_i. For any joint input/reference density, the branches T_i produce positive subnormalized states with trace sum1; applying the individual diamond bounds therefore incurs max_i nu_i, not N times that number. This statewise argument also covers arbitrary references.

With J(E)=(id tensor E)(Phi), the Choi-distance conversion must filter the REFERENCE register. The companion convention note corrects that orientation while retaining the valid factor d. A merely approximately correct reduced program marginal is insufficient to claim the required joint product/decoupling interface.

Fresh independent banks and per-use channel guarantees support the many-gate hybrid sum under arbitrary common intervening processing. This does not establish availability of those banks, independence of several noisy outputs from one conversion, recycling optimality or microscopic compatibility with an untrusted source.
